rules.reason: QCVN 41:2024/BGTVT Appendix E.1(a-b): I.401 marks the start of a priority-road segment. At an uncontrolled intersection on that segment, traffic on the priority road has priority; traffic entering/crossing from another road yields, except priority vehicles. rules.reason: QCVN 41:2024/BGTVT Chapter 5, Article 27 applies to danger and warning signs: they warn road users in advance of hazards or precautions on the route; when encountering one, road users must reduce speed to the necessary level, pay attention and observe, and be ready to handle possible situations to prevent crashes. This general duty does not establish a numeric speed limit or permission for a particular maneuver. The specific hazard meaning remains the identified sign's own catalog meaning.

effects.description: Reduce speed to the level necessary when encountering this danger/warning sign; no numeric speed is inferred.
Pay attention and observe for the warned hazard or precaution.
Be ready to handle possible situations to prevent a crash.
This W-coded sign warns in advance; its specific hazard is supplied by the identified sign meaning.

rules.reason: QCVN 41:2024/BGTVT C.39 and F.11: W.239a may be paired with S.509a, which shows a safe-height indication for passing beneath an overhead power line. Compare only an explicitly stated vehicle height and a confidently linked, legible S.509a value, and require confirmation that the route crosses the indicated location. If the vehicle height exceeds the displayed safe-height value, safe passage is not established and the answer remains CONDITIONAL; do not convert this comparison into an independent legal prohibition. A height at or below the value also does not establish blanket permission. W.239b instead reports actual vertical clearance and must not be conflated with S.509a.

effects.description: S.509a states the safe-height indication associated with W.239a; it is not W.239b's actual physical-clearance measurement.

additional_legal_basis.section_or_figure: Appendix C.39(a-c): W.239a is paired with S.509a; definition of safe height and distinction from actual clearance under W.239b

rules.reason: QCVN 41:2024/BGTVT Appendix E.23a(a-b): I.423a/b identifies a pedestrian crossing place. It may be used alone at an uncontrolled crossing or together with road markings. A road user encountering it must slow down, observe, and give priority to pedestrians crossing; the pictured pedestrian direction must face toward the road. This draft requires actual approach and pedestrian facts and does not infer unrelated right-of-way or permission conclusions.

effects.description: Slow down on approach to the indicated pedestrian crossing.
Pay attention and observe for pedestrians at the indicated crossing.
Give priority to pedestrians crossing when the crossing fact is confirmed.

rules.reason: QCVN 41:2024/BGTVT Appendix D.17(a-d), Figure D.19: R.420 marks the start of the populated-area segment; its scope ends at R.421. For Check Permission questions about speed, use this default populated-area maximum-speed table (km/h): ô tô con, ô tô tải, ô tô chở người and xe mô tô trên 50cc: 60 on a divided road or a one-way road with at least 2 lanes, 50 on a two-way road or a one-way road with 1 lane; xe gắn máy under 50cc, xe máy điện, and xe máy chuyên dùng: 40 on either road type. Treat divided roads and one-way roads with at least 2 lanes as the same category. If the question gives neither vehicle nor road condition, return CONDITIONAL and include the complete table. If it gives only one condition, narrow to the matching row or column, keep CONDITIONAL for the unresolved condition, and state the remaining alternatives. If it gives both, assess the requested speed against the matching maximum; do not infer a missing condition. R.420 signals populated-area rules and requires compliance with any posted P.127 maximum-speed sign, which must also be considered when present.

effects.description: Default populated-area maximum speed (km/h): ô tô con, ô tô tải, ô tô chở người and xe mô tô over 50cc: 60 on a divided road or a one-way road with at least 2 lanes, 50 on a two-way road or a one-way road with 1 lane; xe gắn máy under 50cc, xe máy điện, and xe máy chuyên dùng: 40 on either road type. No vehicle or road condition: return CONDITIONAL with the full table. One condition supplied: narrow to its row or column and remain CONDITIONAL on the missing condition. Both supplied: assess the matching cell. Consider any posted P.127 sign as well. R.420 scope ends at R.421.

additional_legal_basis.section_or_figure: Appendix D.17(a-d), Figure D.19
